description: Redevelopment of the Former Salisbury Road Depot site consisting of the erection of a part 3 and 4 storey residential building, and a part 3 and 5 storey residential building to provide 103 affordable residential flats, private and communal residential amenity space, parking provision (for 86 cars and 74 cycles), servicing and vehicular access from Salisbury Road, and renewable energy generation equipment (in conjunction with associated redevelopment of the Former Featherstone Primary School to provide 146 private residential flats; provision of private and communal residential amenity space, parking provision (for 93 cars and 135 cycles), servicing and vehicular access from Featherstone Road and installation of renewable energy generation equipment)
